subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘intuitive’ to fill in the blank. In a split second, her ________ reaction kicked in as she swiftly reached out to catch the falling glass.
solution:
The correct answer is '**instinctive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**intuitive**" is closely related to "**instinctive**", meaning something done without conscious thought or based on instinct. (स्वाभाविक)
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**instinctive**" best describes the immediate reaction to catch the falling glass.
 
• The other options: "**voluntary**," "**insightful**," and "**shrewd**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In a split second, her instinctive__ reaction kicked in as she swiftly reached out to catch the falling glass.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Voluntary (स्वैच्छिक)**: means done, given, or acting of one's own free will.
 
• **Insightful (सूझ-बूझ से भरा हुआ)**: means having or showing an accurate and deep understanding.
 
• **Shrewd (तेज़-तर्रार)**: means having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute.
